body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #6, company drawn at random (seed 20261203) from IT / Chemicals / Capital Goods names in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.55 (naive base rate 0.5) that: Harsha Engineers discloses a Romania restructuring (downsizing plan, closure, sale or capacity cut of Harsha Engineers Europe SRL) under Reg-30 or in results by 31-Mar-2027. Our reasoning: Management twice said on the 04-Nov-2026 call that concrete details would come 'next quarter … followed by disclosure'; Q3 results are due Feb-2027; but our ledger shows dated promises slipping 3 of 4 times. Naive base: [EST] coin-flip for a 'next quarter' management promise. Resolution: YES if, between 25-Nov-2026 and 31-Mar-2027, a NSE/BSE filing (Reg-30 intimation, board outcome, results notes or investor presentation) describes a specific restructuring action for the Romania subsidiary (headcount/capacity reduction, closure, sale, or restructuring cost); a generic 'evaluating' statement is NO. Source: NSE/BSE announcements. Resolve by 2027-03-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
